summary: The inventory lists a tower at Cary Mound, Wood County, as gone; no source found gives its build, staffing or removal.

facts.status_note: The inventory lists it as gone. No source found gives a removal date or describes the site now.

evidence.supports: Inventory lists a tower at Cary Mound, Wood County, now gone

notes_for_editor: Index-only record: one inventory line giving county, type (tower) and status (gone). Two WebSearch calls and several page reads found no build, staffing, fire, removal or site source. The story is short because the evidence is. The Central US Lookouts Wisconsin page names a 'Cary Bluff' in its miscellaneous list; that is not the same name and was not used. A PeakVisor page on Wood County peaks was seen only in search results and is not cited. Worth checking: the Wisconsin Historical Society Architecture and History Inventory and the Wood County Historical Society.
